title: LUKS2 signature
summary: A LUKS2-encrypted volume begins with 'LUKS\xBA\xBE' followed by version 2 (0x0002). The LUKS2 header is larger (16MB) and supports JSON metadata.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: LUKS2 supports JSON metadata, larger key slots, and integrity protection.
LUKS2 is the default on modern Linux distributions.
